rationale.overall: A more closely matches the reference’s tactile depth, light spill, and secondary-loop presence while keeping the same diagonal composition.
rationale.material: A shows richer volumetric shading, stronger rough-vs-smooth surface contrast, and more convincing glow spill and translucency cues on the loop than B’s flatter, more polished read.
rationale.silhouette: A’s dark diagonal slab plus upright curled loop better echo the reference’s primary and secondary mass; B’s loop is weaker and less distinct.
rationale.smallsize: At 128/32/16, A keeps the diagonal mass, orange edge, and a hint of the loop more legibly, while B loses the secondary form sooner and reads flatter.
